chunks: A number of our companions narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn Asbat from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from 'Uyaynah, the seller of reeds, from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him, 'A woman died and left behind her husband.' He said, 'All of her property belongs to the husband.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to a wife's estate if she dies leaving only her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the principle of 'exclusive inheritance' (al-khalaf) where the husband inherits the entirety of his wife's estate when no other heirs exist. It highlights the Shia juristic view that the husband's share is not limited to the fixed portion (4:12) but expands to encompass the whole in the absence of children or parents, reflecting the comprehensive nature of marital rights in inheritance law.
